hardware.variant: R5 LittleFS appliance, CO5300 RGB565 display and CST92xx touch controller.

Static RV32 ILP32 device application
inputs.revision: Examples e3376c72aa8b7a0fa0827d8964687f51bf9989fb, SDK f19fe129d3b522c3b97c3e6f0ec0deb36d63fd82, Runtime e57a2a1514c9312f64d875d8964696a6501dc0c9

scenario: Build the original QML and present its centered 400 × 400 scene on wsdisplay. Tap the red square, wait one second, then tap it at its new position.
expected: Each tap moves the red square to the right by 50 pixels over 1000 milliseconds.
observed: The application remained active on the display after SSH disconnected. The operator saw two moves and reported visible judder. The input log recorded three press/release pairs. The presented red square moved 0 to 50, 50 to 100 and 100 to 150 pixels along x. Every move included intermediate geometry.
limits: The independent Qt Quick 6.12 host run checks intermediate positions and both endpoints. It does not measure panel refresh rate.

This acceptance covers physical input and on-screen movement. The runner recorded 25 distinct drawn x coordinates per move. The baseline trace has no frame timestamps and does not establish the number of panel refreshes; the operator saw uneven motion.
